ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; approximately 5-8% high-intensity pixels (white speckles) relative to the dominant low-intensity (dark) ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity distribution across the primary lobe surfaces; absence of large-scale contiguous geometric blobs; presence of localized high-intensity point clusters (white) concentrated near the lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped indentation with an approximate vertex angle of 115 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the visible lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged trailing edge with micro-serrations ranging from 2-8 pixels in amplitude; higher frequency of peaks and valleys observed on the distal margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the midline, transitioning to a distinct concave sweep toward the outer lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast white pixels located at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes, forming irregular circular patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two faint, vertically-aligned linear pixel disruptions detected on the medial section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized irregular white calcified clusters at the distal tips of the fluke lobes.
